mainEntity.name: Can I customize my salad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can use the Design Your Own Salad option to choose your preferred lettuce, four regular toppings, one cheese, and one dressing.

mainEntity.name: Where does your ahi come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: We exclusively feature never-frozen local ahi sourced through a Honolulu seafood supplier with full vessel-level traceability.

mainEntity.name: Are your salad dressings made in-house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most of them, yes. Our signature dressings are made in house in small batches through the week.

mainEntity.name: Do your salads contain local produce?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We feature local produce including vine-ripe tomatoes grown in Hauula.

mainEntity.name: Where can I order a salad for pickup?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can order online for fast pickup at any of our six neighborhood restaurants across Oahu.
